reasoning_steps: Thermal resistance of first slab: $R_1 = \frac{x}{K A}$.
Thermal resistance of second slab: $R_2 = \frac{4x}{2K A} = \frac{2x}{K A}$.
Since they are in series, equivalent resistance $R_{eq} = R_1 + R_2 = \frac{3x}{K A}$.
Rate of heat transfer $H = \frac{\Delta T}{R_{eq}} = \frac{T_2 - T_1}{\frac{3x}{KA}} = \frac{KA(T_2 - T_1)}{3x}$.
Comparing with $\frac{A(T_2 - T_1)K}{x} \times f$, we get $f = 1/3$.
